title: High throughput surface plasmon resonance imaging method for clinical detection of presence and strength of binding of IgM, IgG and IgA antibodies against SARS-CoV-2 during CoViD-19 infection
author: Schasfoort, van Weperen, et al.

steps.title: Set up SPR instrument and sensor
steps.instruction: Install the HC30M sensor prism (Xantec Bioanalytics, Düsseldorf, Germany) in the multiplex SPR imaging instrument (IBIS MX96) or Carterra LSA platform; alternatively use the pre‑immobilized COVID‑19 sensor chip (code C19RBDHC30M). Ensure the instrument is powered and software ready.

steps.title: Activate surface with NHS/EDC
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1:1 aqueous solution containing 100 mM N‑hydroxysuccinimide (NHS) and 400 mM N‑ethyl‑N’‑(3‑dimethylaminopropyl) carbodiimide hydrochloride (EDC). Apply the solution to the sensor and incubate for 10 min.

steps.title: Rinse sensor after activation
steps.instruction: Rinse the sensor with water for 20 seconds to remove excess NHS/EDC solution.

steps.title: Immobilize SARS‑CoV‑2 RBD
steps.instruction: Dilute Spike RBD (catalog 40592‑V08H, SINO Biological, Frankfurt, Germany) in immobilization buffer (50 mM sodium acetate, pH 4.8). Expose the sensor to this solution for 20 min to allow covalent coupling via the previously applied NHS/EDC chemistry.

steps.title: Rinse sensor post‑immobilization
steps.instruction: Rinse the sensor with water for 20 seconds to remove unbound RBD.

steps.title: Passivate surface with ethanolamine
steps.instruction: Incubate the sensor in 1 M ethanolamine (pH 8.5) for 10 min to block remaining active esters.

steps.title: Equilibrate sensor in running buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare running buffer consisting of PBS (137 mM NaCl, 10 mM phosphate, 2.7 mM KCl, pH 7.4) supplemented with 1 % bovine serum albumin (BSA), 0.5 % casein, and 0.1 % Tween 20. Flow this buffer over the sensor until a stable baseline is reached.

steps.title: Prepare blocking buffer (if needed)
steps.instruction: For spotter and SPRimager applications, use a blocking buffer of PBS containing 0.1 % Tween 20, 0.5 % BSA, and 0.5 % casein.

steps.title: Select antigen and injection order
steps.instruction: Use recombinant SARS‑CoV‑2 RBD as the immobilized antigen (preferred over S1, S1+S2, or nucleocapsid). Plan antibody detection injections in the MGA sequence: inject anti‑IgM (IgG‑type) first, followed by anti‑IgG, then anti‑IgA, to minimise steric hindrance and non‑specific binding.

steps.title: Run SPRi assay
steps.instruction: Inject patient serum samples over the equilibrated sensor, then sequentially inject the anti‑IgM, anti‑IgG, and anti‑IgA reagents according to the MGA order, recording real‑time binding responses for each isotype.
